 Presented by Giants vs. Commanders: How to Watch, Listen & Live Stream Week 10
 Nov 12, 2026 at 05:00 PM Giants.com 
 Copied! 
 The New York Giants will host the Washington Commanders on Thursday Night Football in Week 10. Kickoff is scheduled for Thursday, November 12th at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime.
 In regular season play, the teams have met 187 times. The Giants lead the all-time series, 107-74-6. In their most recent regular season meeting, the Giants and Commanders tied, 27-27, at Northwest Stadium in Week 5 of the 2026 season. The Giants last defeated the Commanders, 31-19, in Week 11 of the 2023 season.
 The Giants are looking for their first win at home against the Commanders since Week 7 of the 2023 season.
 HOW TO WATCH GIANTS VS. COMMANDERS ON NATIONAL TV 
 Channel: Amazon Prime
 Announcers :  Al Michaels (Play-By-Play), Kirk Herbstreit (Analyst), Kaylee Hartung (Sideline)
 Postgame : Giants Postgame Live presented by Hackensack Meridian  Health hosted by Michelle Gingras immediately following the game on MSG Networks, The DAZN App, YouTube, Giants.com, Giants App, Giants TV
 HOW TO WATCH GIANTS VS. COMMANDERS ON LOCAL TV 
 Channel:  FOX 5 NY
 HOW TO STREAM GIANTS VS. COMMANDERS 
 This week's game can be streamed on NFL+.
 Stream NFL games on NFL+ 
 HOW TO LISTEN TO GIANTS VS. COMMANDERS ON RADIO

 Announcers:  Bob Papa (Play-By-Play), Carl Banks (Analyst), Howard Cross (Sideline)
